agents_doc:
AGENTS
• Firm — has an equity buffer and a set of creditors (drawn as a random directed network, ~avg_degree each).
• Each step: solvent firms receive an i.i.d. shock N(shock_mean, shock_vol). Equity ≤ 0 ⇒ default.
• On default, each creditor loses lgd·exposure; if that pushes a creditor to ≤ 0 it defaults too — the cascade iterates to a fixed point.

Series: solvent_firms, defaults_step (new defaults that step), total_equity (of solvent firms).

model.description: Heterogeneous firms wired into a random exposure network. Each step every solvent firm takes a profit/loss shock; a firm whose equity hits zero defaults and imposes losses on its creditors, which can topple them too — a cascade that resolves within the step. Raise shock volatility or exposure and watch systemic collapses appear suddenly and nonlinearly — the emergent tail risk an aggregate ODE cannot represent.
model.title: Credit cascade (agent-based)
